data.gender_notes: Ghaffar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who covers sins and transgressions. The name Ghaffar carries the meaning “Forgiver” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghaffar usually hope their child will grow to embody forgiver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ghaffar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Forgiver.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghaffar total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: غفار
in_arabic.long_meaning: غفار هو اسم عربي يعني العفو والرحمة، وهو أحد أسماء الله الحسنى في الإسلام، مذكور في القرآن الكريم، ويحمل هذا الاسم دلالة على العفو والرحمة واللطف

in_urdu.name: غفار
in_urdu.meaning: غفار کا معنی عفو و رحمت ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: غفار ایک عربي نام ہے جو عفو و رحمت کے معنی میں آتا ہے، یہ نام اسلام میں الله کے حسني ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، قرآن مجيد میں ذکر ہوا ہے، اور اس نام کا حامل عفو و رحمت اور لطف کا معنی رکھتا ہے

in_hindi.name: ग़फ़्फ़ार
in_hindi.meaning: ग़फ़्फ़ार का अर्थ क्षमा और दया है
in_hindi.long_meaning: ग़फ़्फ़ार एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ क्षमा और दया है, यह नाम इस्लाम में अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, कुरान में उल्लेखित है, और इस नाम का अर्थ क्षमा और दया की भावना को दर्शाता है

in_pashto.name: غفار
in_pashto.meaning: غفار د عفو او رحمت معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: غفار د یو عربي نوم دی چې د عفو او رحمت معنی لري، دا نوم په اسلام کې د الله د ښکلی نومونو څخه دی، په قرآن کريښ میں یاد شوی دی، او دا نوم د عفو او رحمت له معنی څخه دی

in_english.name: Ghaffar
in_english.long_meaning: Ghaffar is an Arabic name that means forgiveness and mercy, it is one of the beautiful names of Allah in Islam, mentioned in the Quran, and the name bearer represents forgiveness and mercy

data.cultural_impact: The name Ghaffar holds great respect and reverence in Islamic culture. It is believed that a person bearing this name carries the qualities of being forgiving and merciful. Thus, Ghaffar represents one who is compassionate towards others and seeks to cover their mistakes and wrongdoings. In a broader societal context, it can serve as a reminder of the importance of forgiveness and compassion in building harmonious communities.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ghaffar holds immense spiritual significance in the Islamic faith. In Quranic terms, Ghaffar refers to Allah Almighty Himself, who is the Forgiver of sins. This name highlights the merciful and compassionate nature of God, emphasizing His infinite capacity to forgive humans for their transgressions. It also underscores the importance of seeking forgiveness from Allah by emphasizing the power and grace of Allah in the process of atonement. Ultimately, Ghaffar serves as a constant reminder of the boundless mercy and forgiveness of Allah, providing comfort and hope to believers.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Forgiver" symbolizes One who covers sins and transgressions.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ghaffar serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of forgiver.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ghaffar is mentioned in the Hadith as a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Ghaffar carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ghaffar was known for his piety and was one of the earliest converts to Islam.

trends: increasing popularity in the Middle East and South Asia
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Ghaffar remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Hassan Ghaffar, a teacher in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, shares that their name Ghaffar meaning "Forgiver" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.
